protocol.roster: Conditional on the final exported roster, including DNP; no claim that signup rosters were archived before tipoff.
protocol.features: Only games dated strictly before target. Target scores/minutes/plus-minus are never prediction inputs. Unknown players are neutral.
protocol.margin: Auxiliary zero-intercept margin calibration on development only, ridge=10; not the UI Monte Carlo score simulator.
protocol.holdoutCaveat: Last 10 games excluded from parameter selection; all outcomes were already available during this retrospective analysis.
protocol.dataVersionCaveat: Replay uses the current corrected historical files, not the exact data versions available on each original date.
protocol.rapm: Existing full-game RAPM remains excluded; no stint RAPM added in this candidate.

holdoutBrierDifference95CI.metric: new minus old Brier; negative is better
holdoutBrierDifference95CI.caveat: small sample; temporal dependence is not modeled
